name: card-resize
title: Card Resize
description: Card resize for vertical reels: a compact status card grows into a detailed one and its hint fades in. Thumbnail treatment and elevation are fields. Brand palette, Montserrat, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="card-resize": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Treatment of the media thumbnail: a plain plate, a hatched surface, or an image plate with a horizon-and-disc glyph.

variables.label: Elevation
variables.description: How far the card lifts off the frame, from a contact shadow to a deep drop.
